events.title: Viral exposure
events.description: A post about the product spreads widely.

events.title: Positive review
events.description: A respected publication reviews the product favourably.

events.title: Influencer mention
events.description: A popular creator recommends the product.

events.title: Supplier discount
events.description: A key supplier cuts prices.

events.title: Unexpected demand
events.description: Demand jumps for reasons outside your control.

events.title: Competitor price war
events.description: Competitors slash prices and bid up advertising.

events.title: Supply disruption
events.description: Supply problems raise costs and delay orders.

events.title: Bad review
events.description: A widely read review criticises the product.

events.title: Economic slowdown
events.description: Customers tighten budgets.

events.title: Employee turnover
events.description: Key people leave; hiring replacements costs time and money.

events.title: Regulatory cost
events.description: New compliance requirements raise overheads.

events.title: Market trend
events.description: Interest in the category grows, and so does competition for attention.

events.title: Seasonal spike
events.description: A seasonal surge lifts demand and ad prices together.

events.title: New technology
events.description: A new technology cuts costs but makes the product look dated.

events.title: Preference shift
events.description: Customer tastes drift away from the current offering.

events.title: State startup incentive
events.description: The state government's startup policy reimburses part of your rent and marketing (states rated Best or Top Performer in the States' Startup Ranking 5.0).

events.title: State regulatory change
events.description: New state compliance rules add filings and fees for a few months.

events.title: Local festival season
events.description: A major regional festival brings a surge of local spending.

events.title: Monsoon flooding
events.description: Heavy rain and flooding disrupt deliveries, supplies and footfall.

events.title: Local talent war
events.description: Well-funded startups nearby bid up salaries for the people you need.

events.title: Infrastructure outage
events.description: Power cuts and network outages interrupt service for a while.
